value.rationale: The fixed four-cycle is the minimal Boolean graph product admitting a distance-two sign anomaly for superunit fractional powers. Its two independently tunable edge-rate classes form a natural weak-coupling degeneracy: amplification amplitude vanishes as the edge ratio while the positivity-recovery time diverges logarithmically. This precise decoupling, unique temporal sign profile, and scalar threshold bracket furnish an interpretable stability boundary for anisotropic non-Markovian graph filters, not a generic relabeling or recomputation of the known isotropic case.
